name: buffering
description: FLT-3: the sensor broker buffers observations while ingestion, then the Observations DB, is stopped; nothing is lost and the backlog drains in order. While the DB is down a model run fails and retries.

steps.caption: Ingestion stops. The DAQ gateway keeps publishing; watch the sensor broker's queue grow by one message per instrument per second.
Ingestion restarts and drains the backlog in order, faster than new messages arrive. Nothing is lost.
The Observations DB stops. Ingestion holds off (it acknowledges only after a commit), so messages queue again.
A run is requested while the DB is down: the model runner cannot read observations and retries with backoff.
The DB is back: the backlog drains, the next retry reads observations and commits the forecast.
